requirement: Declaration of Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer
applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities for retail sale. Imported commodities require importer details.

requirement: Declaration of Generic or Common Name of the Commodity
applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities containing a single or combination commodity.

requirement: Declaration of Net Quantity in Standard SI Units of Weight, Measure or Number
applicability: Applies to all packaged commodities. Standard SI metric units required under Rule 13.

requirement: Declaration of Month and Year of Manufacture, Pre-Packing or Import
applicability: Applies to all retail packaged commodities except bidis, agarbatti, and domestic LPG cylinders under Rule 6(1)(g) Proviso A.

requirement: Declaration of Retail Sale Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes
applicability: Applies to all retail packages except bidis, LPG cylinders, and alcoholic beverages governed by state excise under Rule 6(1)(e) Proviso & Rule 6(1)(g) Proviso C.

requirement: Declaration of Consumer Care Contact Details for Complaints
applicability: Applies to all retail packaged commodities under Rule 6(2).

requirement: Minimum Height of Numerals in Net Quantity Declaration on Principal Display Panel
applicability: Applies to net quantity numerals on the Principal Display Panel under Table I.

requirement: Prohibition Against Selling Pre-Packaged Commodity Exceeding Declared MRP
applicability: Applies whenever a retail sale transaction or retail price observation occurs.
